articles.title: Hyundai becomes first major South Korean company to introduce internal stablecoin transfers
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on a broader shift by companies exploring stablecoins to move money between international operations more efficiently.

articles.title: Crypto defies equity weakness as altcoin optimism builds into the weekend
articles.snippet: The price of bitcoin hit $64,400, retesting a level it failed to penetrate on Monday, with a break higher opening the path toward the June 15 peak of $67,250.

articles.title: Grayscale's CFO exits after 7 years with crypto asset manager
articles.snippet: Edward McGee stepped down after seven years, months after distribution chief John Hoffman left for Ondo Finance.

articles.title: New Hampshire council votes down $100M Bitcoin bonds
articles.snippet: State representative Keith Ammon said the New Hampshire executive council's vote against Bitcoin-backed bonds was “short-sighted,” urging the body to reconsider the measure.

articles.title: Anthropic Removes Hidden Claude Code Tracker After Researchers Raise Privacy Concerns
articles.snippet: The company says the tool was designed to stop abuse and AI model extraction, but critics questioned the use of undisclosed monitoring.
